Full details: Linked Issues check
**Explanation** Objective [`#9299`]: a refused default-models save must show the server's reason in the toast, not the generic "Some of the values aren't valid." text. The diff in modules/model-provider/contract/src/model-provider.errors.ts sets meta: { formErrors: [message] } in the ModelDefaultValidationError constructor. The code stays validation_error, the message is unchanged, and httpStatus 422 and fault "customer" are kept. Every throw site that constructs this class receives the change, which covers the 8 sites listed in the issue. The test file adds a wire assertion for meta.formErrors and a test that runs the serialized error through explainSerializedError and expects the title "Check your input" and the reason as the description. The PR reports that both tests fail before the change and pass after it. Limits of the evidence: I did not read packages/handled-error/src/presentation.ts or the tRPC formatter, so the presenter behavior is taken from the test and the PR description. The test does not run the full tRPC path end to end. The issue's "Minor, same drawer" item (clearing or flagging a stale model pick on scope change) uses optional wording ("could be cleared, or flagged") and is labeled minor. It is not a required objective of the refusal-reason fix, and the PR states it leaves that behavior unchanged. Closing `#9299` without that item is acceptable under this assessment.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check
**Explanation** The whole-PR diff against the merge base touches two files. (1) model-provider.errors.ts: the meta.formErrors addition is the implementation of the objective. The expanded class doc comment explains that change and does not add behavior. (2) model-provider.errors.test.ts: it adds the formErrors wire expectation, the explainSerializedError import, and one new test. These are supporting tests for the same objective. No unrelated code, configuration, or drawer UI changes appear in the reviewed diff. The stale-pick behavior described in the issue is not implemented here. The PR says so explicitly, so its absence is not an out-of-scope change.
